reference_sql:
WITH customer_revenue AS (  -- one row per registered customer with an order line in the period
  SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
deciles AS (  -- one row per customer, with its revenue decile
  SELECT customer_id, revenue,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id) AS decile
  FROM customer_revenue
)
SELECT decile, COUNT(*) AS customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revenue) / SUM(SUM(revenue)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM deciles
GROUP BY decile

  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
deciles AS (  -- one row per customer, with its revenue decile
  SELECT customer_id, revenue,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id) AS decile
  FROM customer_revenue
),
totals AS (  -- one row: the revenue of all these customers
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS all_revenue FROM customer_revenue
)
SELECT d.decile, COUNT(*) AS customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(d.revenue) / MAX(t.all_revenue), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM deciles d
CROSS JOIN totals t
GROUP BY d.decile

solver.query:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
), g AS (
  SELECT customer_id, revenue,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id ASC) AS decile
  FROM rev
)
SELECT decile, COUNT(*) AS customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revenue) / SUM(SUM(revenue)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM g
GROUP BY decile
